rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that makes things easy or accessible.

example.english: This convenience store is really convenient.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 bin6 lei6 dim3 zan1 hai6 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this for a place or location that is conveniently situated or easy to get to.

example.english: The location of this MTR station is very convenient.
example.traditional: 呢個地鐵站位置好就腳。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 wai6 zi3 hou2 zau6 goek3

rows.note: Use this for something that is handy or easy to use or handle.

example.english: This knife is very convenient to use.
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 dou1 jung6 lok6 hou2 seon6 sau2
